product.title: Off Road Las Vegas Tour
product.description: Leave pavement behind on a guided off-road route in the Las Vegas desert with pre-ride orientation, terrain briefings, and staged scenic stops. This experience focuses on technical trail variety including sandy washes, rocky ledges, and open desert sections while maintaining a guide-led pace appropriate for mixed experience levels.
highlights: Guide-led off-road route through Las Vegas desert terrain with changing surface conditions.
Pre-ride safety and equipment briefing before entering technical trail zones.
Route includes washes, rocky rises, and panoramic ridge viewpoints.
Pacing and staging support for mixed rider experience levels.
additionalInfo: Bring sun protection and water for desert conditions.
Driver-license requirements vary by selected vehicle option.
Minimum participant age and height restrictions may apply by vehicle class.

meetingPoint.description: Meeting point details are provided after booking; select Las Vegas pickup locations may be available depending on option.
meetingPoint.name: Las Vegas off-road staging area

items.title: Basecamp check-in
items.description: Arrive at the staging area, complete waiver check-in, and get fitted for required safety gear.

items.title: Safety briefing and controls walkthrough
items.description: Guide covers hand signals, convoy spacing, throttle/brake control, and trail etiquette before departure.

items.title: Sandy wash approach
items.description: Start through broad wash terrain to practice steering and traction in soft surface conditions.

items.title: Rock garden and ledge section
items.description: Progress to technical rocky terrain with slow-speed guide support through uneven ledges.

items.title: High-desert ridgeline overlook
items.description: Pause at elevated viewpoints for photos and terrain interpretation before descending.

items.title: Open desert return loop
items.description: Finish with a faster-paced open section back toward base, adjusted for group comfort.

items.title: Vehicle return and debrief
items.description: Return equipment, review route highlights, and receive post-ride recommendations.

faqs.question: Is this suitable for first-time off-road riders?
faqs.answer: Yes. The experience starts with a safety and controls briefing, and the guide adjusts pacing to group comfort.
